body: Taiwan's aviation industry enters the year-end travel and cargo peak season in the fourth quarter. China Airlines' third-quarter revenue rose 28.01% year on year, and revenue for the first three quarters rose 20%, both record highs. Chairman Kao Hsing-huang said on November 6 that the airline will push hard in the fourth quarter, going all out on both passenger and cargo operations. The airline remains optimistic about the year-end travel peak and the year-end shopping season in Europe and the United States, which are expected to support passenger load factors and cargo demand for traditional-industry and e-commerce shipments.

EVA Air will launch its Delhi, India route in December. General Manager Sun Chia-ming said bookings are very strong, helped by ample demand from India to Taiwan and North America, with the first two flights already full, and domestic travel agencies such as Lion Travel have launched India itineraries. On cargo, Sun said strong AI-related shipment demand is keeping freight rates firm, and EVA Air continues to pursue high-value cargo. Tigerair Taiwan reported earnings per share of NT$5.07 for the first three quarters and said it is optimistic about fourth-quarter passenger demand, expecting operating momentum to remain strong.
en.summary: China Airlines chairman Kao Hsing-huang said the carrier will go all out on passenger and cargo operations in the fourth quarter, while EVA Air said sales for its new Delhi route opening in December are strong, with the first two flights already full.
en.title: China Airlines vows to push hard in Q4; EVA Air's Delhi flights sell out first two departures

body: 航空業第4季迎年終旅遊與貨運旺季。華航第3季營收年增28.01%，前3季營收年增20%，雙創歷史新高；董事長高星潢6日受訪表示，第4季會「狠狠往上拚」，不管客運和貨運都會全力以赴。華航持續看好年底旅遊旺季以及歐美年終購物季，可望繼續帶動客運載客率，以及傳產、電商等空運主力產品貨運鋪貨潮。
長榮航空12月將開航印度德里，總經理孫嘉明表示，受惠印度到台灣或到北美的客源充裕，銷售訂位表現非常好，首兩班已客滿，國內旅行社如雄獅已推出印度航線旅程。貨運方面，孫嘉明表示，AI出貨需求旺盛，帶動運價持穩續強，長榮航空持續積極爭取高附加價值貨源。台灣虎航先前已公布前3季財報，每股盈餘5.07元；展望第4季，台灣虎航表示樂觀看待客運需求，第4季營運將可延續高檔動能。
zh.summary: 航空業第4季迎年終旅遊與貨運旺季，華航董事長高星潢表示第4季客貨運全力以赴；長榮航空12月開航印度德里，總經理孫嘉明表示銷售表現強勁，首兩班已客滿。
zh.title: 華航第4季要「狠狠往上拚」，長榮航印度德里直航首兩班客滿
